crossProtocol.title: Cross-protocol forwarding
crossProtocol.intro: Add the {header}: {values} header to POST /v1/chat/completions to choose the upstream protocol, regardless of the channel's own protocol.

status.unknown: Not readable from this console — maintained in site settings (module 08).
status.off: Off — requests that carry the header are rejected with 403.
status.on: On — requests that carry the header are forwarded to the selected upstream protocol.

crossProtocol.defaultOff: The switch defaults to off. While it is off, a request that carries x-newtg-protocol fails with 403 instead of being relayed.
crossProtocol.managedBy: The switch is maintained by site settings (module 08). M4 ships no settings API, so this console cannot read or change it.
crossProtocol.editableDeferred: An editable switch and protocol mapping are deferred until module 08's settings API is available; no control is shown here until then.
